result.notes: I removed other_conditions (the Property Rent Control Status inquiry via SeeClickFix). It is an administrative procedure for checking status, not a condition on buildings, units or owners. The D036 passage on owner-occupied multifamily homes of four or fewer units concerns the state liability-insurance requirement (N.J. Statute §40A:10A-1), not rent-control coverage. It was not used for owner_occupied_exemption_max_units. DX02, DX04, DX06 and DX11 concern the separate algorithmic rent-fixing ordinance (§218-12) and contain no coverage terms for Chapter 260.
